packages.pmkid_runtime_note: Dependency archive coverage is not feature compatibility. PMKID is blocked by the application when hcxdumptool API is not adapted; do not replace firmware packages from another release.

router_model_verification.note: Do not conflate Q30 with Q30 Pro; requires actual distribution, version, target and architecture.

maintenance.model_policy: Retain verified source URLs and unknown models; platform coverage alone never confirms every model or third-party firmware.
